node.statement: Under the fixed data and radius bounds of 1.1, lem-routef-functional-calculus-closeness gives ||tilde-Phi-Phi||_cb<=C_theta*eta, hence ||(tilde-Phi_n-Phi_n)(Z)||<=C_theta*eta*||Z|| for every Z in M_n(B(H)); and lem-routef-delta-normalization-closeness gives that Delta is UCP and ||Delta-tilde-Delta||_cb<=C_Delta*eta, hence ||(Delta_n-tilde-Delta_n)(W)||<=C_Delta*eta*||W|| for every W in M_n(S.B).
